mapper.select: SELECT duo.dates, duo.pkg, duo.version, IFNULL(sum(duo.online_time), 0) total_online_time, IFNULL(count(DISTINCT duo.user_id), 0) total_user_num, IFNULL(sum(case when dui.user_id is not null then duo.online_time end), 0) new_user_online_time, IFNULL(count(DISTINCT case when dui.user_id is not null then dui.user_id end), 0) new_user_num FROM dwd_user_online duo LEFT JOIN dim_user_info dui on (duo.user_id = dui.user_id and dui.dates = duo.dates) where duo.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY duo.dates, duo.pkg, duo.version
